description: A 13-model Lego assembly studio with ten 3,000–3,900-piece mega presets, lazy one-at-a-time loading, step instructions, finished preview, explode view, JSON persistence and a custom authoring studio.

tokens.note: Snapshot from the OpenCode session record when the multi-model build was packaged. total = input + output + reasoning. Cache reads/writes are reported separately because they are a subset of context usage. The final response and the publishing push are outside this count.

cost.note: As reported by the OpenCode session record.

verification: 13 presets generated and audited: 250, 1,099, 1,336, and ten 3,300–3,900-piece mega builds.
Every preset: zero out-of-bounds bricks and zero overlapping stud cells.
Lazy switching verified: only the active model's placement array and instanced batches are retained; per-model progress resumes correctly.
Finished preview verified at step 1 and step 400: all pieces shown, saved step unchanged, snapping disabled until Build is selected.
Completion verified on the 3,900-piece Titan Mecha; completion dialog and dynamic stats render correctly.
JSON progress import into a 3,600-piece preset verified; custom authoring import and save/load paths verified.
Authoring mode verified against a 3,900-piece active model with a 24×24 custom board and clean return to the preset.
Responsive layout checked at 390px; no horizontal overflow; scrollable 13-model library at 178px.
All thirteen models rendered in headless Chrome without JavaScript errors.
credits: Built with OpenCode and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash. The 13-model registry, procedural mega builders, lazy loader, finished preview, authoring studio, UI, screenshots, and documentation were produced in a single agent session.
